messages.author: 370a18caf4e9cdf7
messages.subject: Part 2 Output
parts:
Hi all,

Middle of the road R and GGIR user here. To answer one of my current questions, I'd need to have output from Part 2 (MVPA) at a more refined level than the day (say, the minute). Is there an argument within GGIR that makes this possible? I've been looking, but I don't think I've found what I'm looking for. Any help is appreciated; thanks in advance.

Matt

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 2 Output
parts:
Hi Matt,
See argument qwindow that allows you to segment the output per hour of the day.
Further, the milestone data stored in the RData files or optionally
exported to csv contain metric values per epoch (default 5 second).
Vincent
